details.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT("satscores"."cds") AS "school_count" FROM "satscores" WHERE "satscores"."avgscrmath" > 400 AND "satscores"."rtype" = 'virtual' ORDER BY "school_count" ASC

details.question: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
details.sql: SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_eligible_free_rate FROM frpm f JOIN satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds WHERE CAST(s.numge1500 AS NUMERIC) / CAST(s.enroll12 AS NUMERIC) > 0.3

details.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
details.sql: SELECT schools.charternum, AVG(satscores.avgscrwrite) AS avg_write_score FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.cdscode WHERE satscores.avgscrwrite > 499 GROUP BY schools.charternum ORDER BY avg_write_score DESC

details.question: List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.
details.sql: SELECT f."School Name", s.street FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.school WHERE ABS(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

details.question: Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K-12 is more than 0.1 and test takers whose test score is greater than or equal to 1500?
details.sql: SELECT DISTINCT frpm."School Name" FROM frpm JOIN satscores ON frpm."cdscode" = satscores."cds" WHERE frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1 AND satscores."numge1500" > 0

details.question: Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT is grater than 400, what is the funding type of these schools?
details.sql: SELECT s.school, s.fundingtype, AVG(ss.avgscrmath) as avg_math_score FROM schools s JOIN satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE s.city = 'Riverside' GROUP BY s.school, s.fundingtype HAVING AVG(ss.avgscrmath) > 400 ORDER BY avg_math_score DESC

details.question: State the names and full communication address of high schools in Monterey which has more than 800 free or reduced price meals for ages 15-17?
details.sql: SELECT s.school AS "School Name", s.mailstreet || ' ' || s.mailstrabr || ', ' || s.mailcity || ' ' || s.mailzip || ', ' || s.mailstate AS "Full Communication Address" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.soc = 'HS' AND s.county = 'Monterey' AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800 ORDER BY s.school

details.question: What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after 1991 or closed before 2000? List the school names along with the score. Also, list the communication number of the schools if there is any.
details.sql: SELECT s.school, s.phone, AVG(sc.avgscrwrite) AS avg_writing_score FROM schools s JOIN satscores sc ON s.cdscode = sc.cds WHERE (s.opendate > '1991-01-01' OR s.closeddate < '2000-01-01') GROUP BY s.school, s.phone

details.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
details.sql:
WITH avg_diff AS (
  SELECT AVG("Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "avg_difference"
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Local'
)
SELECT s.school, s.doctype
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Local'
  AND "Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > (SELECT "avg_difference" FROM avg_diff)

details.question: What is the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools with the highest enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12?
details.sql: SELECT "School Name", "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS "Eligible Free Rate (K-12)" FROM frpm WHERE "Low Grade" = 1::text AND "High Grade" = 12::text ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 10

details.question: What is the eligible free or reduced price meal rate for the top 5 schools in grades 1-12 with the highest free or reduced price meal count of the schools with the ownership code 66?
details.sql: SELECT f."School Name", f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_rate FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f."School Code" = s."ncesschool" WHERE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 1 AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 12 AND CAST(s."soc" AS INTEGER) = 66 ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
details.sql: SELECT s.street, s.city, s.zip, s.state FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode ORDER BY f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" ASC LIMIT 1

details.question: Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT? Indicate their full names.
details.sql: SELECT s.admfname1, s.admlname1, s.school, sa.numge1500 FROM schools s JOIN satscores sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds WHERE s.admfname1 IS NOT NULL AND s.admlname1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa.numge1500 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

details.question: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
details.sql: SELECT AVG(s.satscores.numtsttakr) FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE sch.city = 'Fresno' AND sch.opendate >= '1980-01-01' AND sch.opendate <= '1980-12-31'

details.question: What is the telephone number for the school with the lowest average score in reading in Fresno Unified?
details.sql: SELECT sch.phone FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE sch.district = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY s.avgscrread ASC LIMIT 1

details.question: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci Ulrich? List the schools and the corresponding average writing scores.
details.sql: SELECT "satscores"."sname" AS "sname", AVG("satscores"."avgscrwrite") AS "avg_writing_score" FROM "satscores" WHERE "satscores"."dname" = 'Ricci Ulrich' GROUP BY "satscores"."sname" ORDER BY "avg_writing_score" DESC

details.question: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."state" AS "state", COUNT("frpm"."cdscode") AS "enrollees_grade_1_12" FROM "schools" JOIN "frpm" ON "schools"."cdscode" = "frpm"."cdscode" WHERE "schools"."soctype" = 'special' AND "frpm"."Low Grade" <= 1 AND "frpm"."High Grade" >= 12 GROUP BY "schools"."state" ORDER BY "enrollees_grade_1_12" DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."opendate" AS "opendate", AVG("schools"."school") AS "schools_opened_per_month" FROM "schools" WHERE "schools"."county" = 'Alameda County' AND "schools"."district" = 'Elementary School District' AND "schools"."opendate" >= '1980-01-01' AND "schools"."opendate" <= '1980-12-31' GROUP BY "schools"."opendate" ORDER BY "opendate" ASC LIMIT 12

details.question: What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT("schools"."school") AS "unified_count" FROM "schools" WHERE "schools"."county" = 'Orange County' AND "schools"."statustype" = 'merged Unified School District' LIMIT 1

details.question: What is the postal street address for the school with the 7th highest Math average? Indicate the school's name.
details.sql: SELECT s.school, s.mailstreet FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode JOIN satscores sc ON f.cdscode = sc.cds ORDER BY sc.avgscrmath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

details.question: What is the total number of non-chartered schools in the county of Los Angeles with a percent (%) of eligible free meals for grades 1 through 12 that is less than 0.18%?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 'N' AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.18

details.question: How many students from the ages of 5 to 17 are enrolled at the State Special School school in Fremont for the 2014-2015 academic year?
details.sql: SELECT "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE f."School Name" = 'State Special School' AND s.city = 'Fremont' AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

details.question: Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?
details.sql: WITH school_data AS (SELECT "School Name" AS school_name, "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" AS frpm_pct FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Low Grade" = 'K' AND "High Grade" = '9') SELECT school_name, frpm_pct FROM school_data

details.question: Between San Diego and Santa Barbara, which county offers the most number of schools that does not offer physical building? Indicate the amount.
details.sql:
WITH school_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.county AS county_name,
    COUNT(s.school) AS school_count
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sc ON s.cdscode = sc.cds
  WHERE s.county IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
    AND s.virtual = 'Y'
  GROUP BY s.county
)
SELECT county_name, school_count
FROM school_counts
ORDER BY school_count DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT("schools"."gsoffered") AS "grade_span_offered", COUNT("schools"."longitude") AS "longitude" FROM "schools" ORDER BY "longitude" DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: Of the schools that offers a magnet program serving a grade span of Kindergarten to 8th grade, how many offers Multiple Provision Types? List the number of cities that offers a Kindergarten to 8th grade span and indicate how many schools are there serving such grade span for each city.
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."city" AS "city", COUNT(*) AS "total_schools", COUNT(DISTINCT "schools"."fundingtype") AS "multiple_provision_types" FROM "schools" WHERE "schools"."magnet" = 1 AND "schools"."gsoffered" = 'K-8' GROUP BY "schools"."city" ORDER BY "multiple_provision_types" DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
details.sql: SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS Percent_Eligible_Free_K12, s."district" AS District_Code FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f."School Code" = s."ncesschool" WHERE s."admfname1" = 'Alusine'

details.question: What are the valid e-mail addresses of the administrator of the school located in the San Bernardino county, City of San Bernardino City Unified that opened between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010 whose school types are public Intermediate/Middle Schools and Unified Schools?
